MockShareRegistry.role: Records underlying share units backing the mock equity token

VenueRegistry.role: Maps a venueId to its adapter address

PancakeSwapAdapter.role: AMM execution venue against the real PancakeSwap V2 router

PrimaryReserveVault.role: Holds the stable reserve backing primary-market redemptions

PrimaryVenueAdapter.role: Primary market: mints/redeems the equity token at par

SettlementEngine.role: Executes settlement: pulls funds, calls the venue, applies the fee

Router.role: Resolves a venueId (or runs best execution) and calls SettlementEngine

TradingModule.role: Safe module granting scoped, capped trading authority to an operator
